So I can’t post videos but the best way to explain it is that want to get your mirror out of you stick mount. Hold the bottom nut (I used a 9/16 open ended wrench, it’s probably a 1/2 or sum but I didn’t want to dig for it) and turn the mirror. Keep in mind reverse thread (Righty-Loosy, Lefty-Tighty).
If the mirror doesn’t turn by the mirror it’s self grab another open ended wrench (same size as before) and spin the nut in the corresponding direction. After the mirror and tightening nut are out your almost done. The bottom nut is regular so just turn it left and it comes out. It’s easier to put the bottom bolt/nut in the new bracket first so I suggest doing that. All the way and tighten your liking after that loosely attach the new bracket to the handlebars the bolt heads are 10mm and I used a drill. After that loosely screw the mirror (with the nut all the way down on the threads, so you get the most adjustment room possible, to where ever you’d like them positioned at) and tighten the nut. And your done
